gen-luckiest-guy-gf-onest: Luckiest Guy shouts in ink that looks poured, every line the same width. Onest follows with short ascenders over big round bowls, so a long page of text goes down smoothly and friendly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-orienta: Orienta opens up its hollow-reed counters and keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, a quiet modern sans. Luckiest Guy is the loud one, with a line that never swells.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads clean and contemporary, its curves left open and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. Luckiest Guy sits above it as an outline you could trace with a finger; if anything needs resizing, nudge the body up a little.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-parkinsans: Cheerful from the first word, Luckiest Guy brings a mean, high-set line and an e that opens to the right. Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, so paragraphs stay crisp.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-pathway-extreme: Rounded-nib strokes that never swell at their ends give Luckiest Guy its loud, poured look. Shrink that heading and it loses punch, while Pathway Extreme, with its stubby ascenders and big x-height, holds up well even when set large.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters wide like a pried oyster shell and lifts its x-height high. And Luckiest Guy, with no thinning anywhere in its line, hands off to a sans-serif that glides through long paragraphs.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-prompt: Big, brash and grinning, Luckiest Guy hits with a single line weight and a mean, high-set stance. And Prompt settles beside it with oversized small letters and open apertures, friendly where the heading is rowdy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-pt-sans-caption: Luckiest Guy brings a loud, cheerful shout with crossbars as thick as its stems. PT Sans Caption answers with unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase, a sturdy sans that steadies the page beneath the noise.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-puritan: Stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon give Luckiest Guy its poured, cheerful loudness. The pair's strength is the handoff: Puritan, a clean sans-serif with oversized e and a counters, takes over gently.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-questrial: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, its mean high line poured at a single width. Questrial answers that with a flat, stencil-cut sans-serif whose open shapes make the pair's strongest quality a lively shout meeting a tidy, modern voice.
